metadata.description: Local development marketplace for this repository. Install from a source clone only — this is not a public distribution channel, and installing from it does not produce a working plugin on its own.

plugins.name: gil-companion-prototype
plugins.description: GIL for Claude Code — local development install. Requires a source clone and a locally built GIL Core: run plugins/gil-companion-prototype/make-core.sh before installing, which needs Rust and cargo. Without that build the plugin installs but reports agent_surface: unavailable.
